questions.question: If 16 June 2001 is Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 21 June 2009?
questions.solution:
Given: **16 June 2001** is **Saturday**.

Now,

16 June 2001 to 16 June 2009 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year).

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year.

So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, **16 June 2009** will be Saturday + 3 = Tuesday.

Now, the number of days between 16 June 2009 to 21 June 2009 = 5 days

So, **21 June 2009** will be Tuesday + 5 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Which of the following options best describes the purpose of the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) scheme, 2019?

• Workers between the age of **18-40 years** with a monthly income of less than **Rs. 15,000 **are eligible for the scheme.

• **Pradhan Mantri Vidya Lakshmi Yojana** provides** education loans** to students.
 
 
• The **Vidya Lakshmi Portal **is a unique platform designed for students who are looking for an education loan.
 
• It prepares applications for **government scholarships and educational loans** and offers students a** single-window electronic platform** to access information. 
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana **provides** insurance coverage **to** farmers** against crop loss or damage due to natural calamities.
